title: Dexora + RL-100: Real-World DexHand RL
description: Survey and prototype a Dexora + RL-100 path for real-world dexterous-hand offline-to-online reinforcement learning.
summary: Use Dexora as the dexterous demonstration/data source and port RL-100’s BC, offline RL, real-robot rollout, online RL, and data-merge loop to DexHand. First verify the observation/action adapter and one reproducible real-robot task, then add DexHand-specific reward, safety, reset, correction data, and high-DoF control optimization.

subprojects.label: A
subprojects.title: Dexora adapter
subprojects.body: Verify observation/action semantics, timing, camera alignment, and conversion into the RL-100 training and replay format.

subprojects.label: B
subprojects.title: RL-100 reproduction
subprojects.body: Run BC → offline RL → real rollout → online RL → data merge on one bounded DexHand task.

subprojects.label: C
subprojects.title: DexHand optimization
subprojects.body: Add high-DoF action structure, contact-aware reward, correction data, safe exploration, and reliable reset/recovery.

references.title: Dexora
references.notes: Dexterous real-world dataset and embodiment reference.

risks_decisions: Treat Dexora-to-RL-100 compatibility as a hypothesis until action semantics, timing, and dataset conversion are verified.
Do not start online real-robot RL before reward/success, reset, joint/workspace limits, intervention, and E-stop gates pass.
The contribution should come from the DexHand-specific real-world flywheel and optimization, not from a repository-level port alone.

timeline.target_note: Promote after one verified adapter and one bounded real-robot baseline.
